paragraph: [Digital.ao, the incubator backed by INFOSI, graduated its first cohort of seven startups in March 2025](<https://pti.ao/digital-ao-escolhe-50-projectos-para-nova-fase-de-incubacao/>). [It then chose 50 projects from more than 200 bids for its next yearly cycle](<https://pti.ao/digital-ao-escolhe-50-projectos-para-nova-fase-de-incubacao/>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 the government and the African Development Bank Group inaugurated the Luanda Science and Technology Park](<https://itweb.africa/article/angola-launches-luanda-technology-park/8OKdWqDX2nRqbznQ>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In February 2026 [BujaHub said it had run a three-month incubation programme for 70 selected entrepreneurs](<https://bujahub.bi/moonshot-program/>). [BujaHub has offices in Bujumbura and Gitega](<https://bujahub.bi/moonshot-program/>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, [the KIT Digital Innovation Hub was incubating 13 Shark Tank Burundi startups in its ICANZO TECH programme](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/kit-digital-innovation-hub_icanzotech-kithub-sharktankburundi-activity-7525403169837883392-1SXg>). No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

Since November 2025 [the Cyber Incub programme at the L'Envol incubator in Abomey-Calavi has supported ten cybersecurity startup teams](<https://www.lanation.bj/numerique/cyber-incub-des-solutions-en-cybersecurite-en-maturation-a-abomey-calavi>). [The programme closed in Cotonou in September 2026 with three winners](<https://lepotentiel.bj/?p=88236>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, [MTN Benin's Innovation Lab chose five startups for its second cohort](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/2407-57714-mtn-benin-selects-five-startups-for-second-innovation-lab-cohort>). On 4 November 2026 [The Council of Ministers approved a pilot to build two Innobox innovation hubs in Parakou and Porto-Novo](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0511-60528-benin-plans-digital-fabrication-hubs-to-boost-local-innovation>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

Orange Burkina Faso's 2024 report says [its Orange Digital Center acceleration programme and Damina incubation programme supported 30 startups](<https://www.cfinance.news/article/orange-burkina-faso-257-milliards-f-cfa-dinvestissements-pour-linclusion-numerique-des-populations/>). [Orange Fab in Ouagadougou chose five start-ups for its fourth nine-month season in April 2025](<https://faso7.com/2025/04/11/orange-digital-center-cinq-start-ups-retenues-pour-la-quatrieme-saison-de-son-programme-dacceleration-orange-fab/>). In the last twelve months, [it chose five more for its fifth season in July 2026](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/orange-digital-center-burkina-faso_orangefab-orangedigitalcenter-orangeburkinafaso-activity-7481018655280095233-ytWB>). On 23 May 2026 [Sahal Tech opened its Smart Innovation Hub](<https://burkina24.com/2026/05/23/souverainete-numerique-sahal-tech-veut-former-une-nouvelle-generation-de-leaders-technologiques/>), a training and innovation centre with no incubation cohort reported. No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

On 10 March 2026 [the Botswana Innovation Fund and Scalar International launched a 12-month programme in Gaborone](<https://techcabal.com/2026/03/17/botswana-to-support-clean-energy-startups/>). [It supports ten climate and digital startups](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/brief/brief-simple/botswana-rolls-out-innovation-accelerator-for-climate-digital-startups>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, [the Botswana Tech Fund named seven startups, three from Botswana, for its first three-month accelerator cohort](<https://www.bwtechzone.com/2026/10/botswana-tech-fund-announces-first.html>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

[Fondation Bangui Hub says it was created in 2023 as the country's first incubator for youth and diaspora](<https://www.banguihub.org/a-propos/>). [President Touadéra inaugurated its youth business incubator in Bangui on 30 October 2024](<https://www.journaldebangui.com/rca-inauguration-du-premier-incubateur-dentreprise-pour-la-jeunesse/>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [Centra News reported that the incubator had trained over 800 young entrepreneurs](<https://centranews.org/centrafrique-une-table-ronde-sur-lentrepreneuriat-et-le-developpement-economique-organisee-par-bangui-hub/>). On 30 October 2026 [FAFECA launched a digital incubator for women entrepreneurs in Bangui](<https://www.fafeca.org/actualites/la-fafeca-inaugure-son-incubateur-numerique-a-bangui-en-presence-du-ministre-ngate-robard>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

Côte d'Ivoire's digital ministry [selected 32 firms from more than 150 applicants on 4 November 2026](<https://www.afriksoir.net/cote-divoire-32-entreprises-du-numerique-selectionnees-pour-accelerer-leur-croissance/>) for 24 months of support. It had [launched the two programmes in July 2026](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/la-cote-divoire-lance-deux-accelerateurs-pour-faire-emerger-ses-champions-du-numerique>). In the last twelve months, [Hub Ivoire Tech, an incubator attached to the presidency in Abidjan, admitted its first cohort of 10 startups in 2026](<https://digitalmag.ci/ama-ouattara-hub-ivoire-tech-le-but-de-notre-incubateur-est-de-deceler-des-talents/>). The hubs on record, IvorTech and the [UniPod](<https://www.aip.ci/aip-le-pnud-dote-la-cote-divoire-de-son-premier-pole-dinnovation-et-de-technologie-unipod/>), are both in Abidjan. No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities, or that a technology park has tenants. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

On 4 June 2025 [Orange Digital Center's OrangeFab accelerator presented its third cohort of seven startups in Douala](<https://ecomatin.net/7-startups-camerounaises-beneficiaires-du-programme-orangefab-by-orange-digital-center>). [Hubs and incubators are named in Douala, Yaoundé and Buea (ActivSpaces, SM Ventures), per TechCabal](<https://techcabal.com/2025/07/01/tnw-cameroon-algeria/>). In the last twelve months, in December 2025, [the incubator Enovation Factory and UNDP launched Scale 32](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/cameroon-enovation-factory-partners-with-undp-to-support-local-startups>). No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. [Douala Tech Park opened in October 2024 on the JFN campus in Douala](<https://africtelegraph.com/blog/alphonse-nafack-structure-douala-tech-park-en-sas-au-cameroun/>), with no named cohort of startups. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

[Silikin Village in Kinshasa opened on 10 October 2024](<https://bankable.africa/en/business-climate/1110-390-dr-congo-president-tshisekedi-inaugurates-new-tech-and-entrepreneur-hub-in-kinshasa>) and offers training and incubation programmes for startups. [The seventh Orange Corners cohort supported young entrepreneurs in Kinshasa, Goma and Lubumbashi in 2025](<https://numerico.cd/fr/article/rdc-7-incubateurs-tech-qui-faconnent-lavenir-numerique-du-pays>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [TechCabal described it as a 9,500 m2 hub with coworking and an acceleration programme](<https://techcabal.com/2026/03/10/francophone-weekly-by-techcabal-015/>). No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [Eni and Joule's Yasika programme in Brazzaville took in 13 startups for incubation](<https://www.eni.com/joule/en-IT/media/2026/05/yasika-second-edition-is-brought-to-life-with-bootcamp.html>). On 4 February 2026 [the Bantulab incubator in Brazzaville took its first laureate, Smartmbongo, into a 24-month programme](<https://www.vox.cg/accompagnement-intensif-de-24-mois-pour-la-premiere-entreprise-laureate-de-bantulab/>). In May 2024 [the TotalEnergies incubator in Pointe-Noire chose the start-up Noki Noki](<https://afriqueitnews.com/startups/la-start-up-noki-noki-leve-3-millions-de-dollars-en-seed-pour-revolutionner-la-livraison-de-proximite-en-afrique/>) for two years of incubation. No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

In April 2026 [the Comor'Lab incubator launched the Wamanga wa Komor programme](<https://www.lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/hackathon-wamanga-wa-komor-la-premi%C3%A8re-phase-retient-10-projets-innovants-.html>). It trained 100 young people, and its 10 finalists continue in incubation. [Innov'Lab, set up by the chamber of commerce in 2017](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/tech-stars/comores-innovlab-accompagne-les-entrepreneurs-de-lidee-a-la-realisation-de-leur-projet>), runs pre-incubation, two-year incubation and acceleration. In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [the Technopole Numérique, four months into its pilot, had trained 34 students](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/société/technopole-numérique-34-jeunes-reçoivent-leurs-attestations-.html>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In August 2025 [the government's BOOST.CV accelerator, funded by the World Bank, took cohorts of 57 tech and digital startups](<https://www.digital.cv/blog/boost-cv-acolhe-57-startups-cabo-verdianas-no-lancamento-dos-grupos-1-e-2>). On 27 June 2025 [it held a session at the Tech Park in Mindelo](<https://mindelinsite.com/economia/programa-para-acelerar-startups-e-negocios-digitais-chega-a-s-vicente/>), after one in Santo Antão the day before. [The African Development Bank said the Mindelo park hosted ten companies and 125 employees](<https://www.afdb.org/en/news-and-events/press-releases/african-development-bank-funds-second-tech-park-mindelo-83646>). In the last twelve months, on 29 July 2026, [the finance ministry invited bids to equip the park's second phase](<https://static.expressodasilhas.cv/media/pub/v2/pdf/2026/07/1785347487426.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In September 2025 [the Centre de Leadership et de l'Entrepreneuriat unveiled the first cohort of its Startup Djibouti programme](<https://www.lanation.dj/mden-cle-banque-mondiale-la-premiere-cohorte-de-startup-djiboutien-devoilee-en-grande-pompe/>). In the last twelve months, in June 2026, [La Nation said the centre runs incubation and acceleration programmes for startups](<https://www.lanation.dj/innovation-et-entrepreneuriat-le-cle-saffirme-comme-le-moteur-de-la-nouvelle-dynamique-economique/>). On 28 September 2026 [Wingu Africa offered the communications ministry its new innovation centre as an incubator](<https://www.adi.dj/article/138942>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

On 23 December 2025 [Ooredoo Algérie said its T-Start incubation programme had 21 startups in incubation and took in four more](<https://www.ooredoo.dz/documents/20121/0/Ooredoo+Alg%C3%A9rie+accompagne+l%E2%80%99%C3%A9mergence+de+quatre+projets+innovants+-+FR.pdf/8c0c0737-d175-6af8-321d-0486573bb6a8?t=1766572881411>). In the last twelve months, on 18 April 2026, [Algeria launched its first AI and cybersecurity start-up cluster](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/algeria-unveils-first-ai-and-cybersecurity-start-up-cluster>). In May 2026 [The telecoms ministry said incubators operate at Sidi-Abdellah, Bordj Bou Arréridj and Oran](<https://www.mpt.gov.dz/technology-parks/>). It names no cohort in any. No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In October 2026 the ICT minister said [24 innovation centres had been created](<https://www.tafsela.net/98622>), which incubate startups and train young people. [The minister said the 24 innovation centres are spread across the governorates](<https://www.tafsela.net/98622>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, Telecom Egypt's WE Innovate Star programme [graduated 20 cybersecurity and AI startups in November 2026](<https://egyptinnovate.com/en/news/minister-of-communications-attends-graduation-of-20-startups-under-we-innovate-star-program>). No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

In April 2025 [Shabait, the information ministry's site, said the NUEYS Youth Innovation and Entrepreneurship Hub runs a three-level training programme](<https://shabait.com/2025/04/09/the-innovation-hub-a-center-for-creatinity-and-progress/>). [Each level lasts six months and covers electronics, Python, Scratch, robotics and soldering](<https://shabait.com/2025/04/09/the-innovation-hub-a-center-for-creatinity-and-progress/>). [The trainees are mainly Grade 9 to 11 students](<https://shabait.com/2025/04/09/the-innovation-hub-a-center-for-creatinity-and-progress/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incubation or acceleration programme for startups has been found. Establishing would need a hub or incubator in service running an incubation or acceleration programme with a cohort of startups.

In the last twelve months, [in November 2026 the AI UniPod in Addis Ababa ran a 10-day residency for 51 AI startup founders](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_9899270>), from 12 African countries. On 18 May 2026 [the Entrepreneurship Development Institute launched iDisruptHub](<https://www.edi-ethiopia.org/detail.php?nid=581944>), with incubation, seed funding and acceleration tracks. In April 2025 [iceaddis's Venture Meda accelerator took a third cohort of eight startups](<https://addisinsight.net/2025/04/15/venture-meda-job-creation-through-incubation-and-acceleration-in-ethiopia/>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In November 2025 the digital economy minister told the ITU that the [Centre gabonais de l'innovation incubates start-ups](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/meetings/wp-content/uploads/IPS/documents/22/31_WTDC-25-HLS-Statement-Doumba-Gabon.pdf>). SING SA, the state digital incubator in Libreville, [runs the Pivot 4.0 incubation and acceleration programme](<https://www.gabonreview.com/dg-limoge-locaux-vides-projet-de-fusion-vers-une-disparition-en-catimini-de-la-sing-sa/>). In the last twelve months, on 3 November 2026, the agriculture and digital economy ministries [named the centre their technical body for innovation and incubation](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-agriculture-agri-track-241-une-plateforme-numerique-pour-accompagner-la-filiere-avicole/>). In August 2026 L'Union reported that [SING had been placed under interim management](<https://union.sonapresse.com/fr/sing-une-restructuration-en-vue-apres-le-depart-du-directeur-general>), not closed. No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

On 29 October 2026 [the Kosmos Innovation Center and the Mastercard Foundation named ten agritech startups to enter its incubation programme](<https://www.businesstechafrica.co.za/article/ghana-awards-100-000-to-ten-agritech-startups-to-expand-agricultural-businesses>). In the last twelve months, on 12 August 2026, [Mobile Money Fintech Limited launched the three-month MoMo Fintech Lab with Hubtel](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/08/17/hubtel-partners-with-momo-fintech-lab-to-back-ghanas-next-fintech-innovators/>). On 13 April 2026 [UNICEF's Start-up Lab, run by MEST Africa, took its sixth cohort of 20 startups](<https://www.unicef.org/ghana/press-releases/unicef-ghana-welcomes-20-social-impact-startups-2026-start-lab-cohort>). In October 2025 [Ghana Digital Centres told a parliamentary committee that the Accra Digital Centre hosts more than 60 technology companies](<https://www.pulse.com.gh/story/parliaments-select-committee-on-communications-innovations-visits-ghana-digital-centres-limited-2025100510530537480>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

[AfriLabs lists Trustee Sas and Incubateur Saboutech as member hubs in Guinea](<https://new.afrilabs.com/index.php/hub_country/guinea/>), as at 2025. Saboutech calls itself [Guinea's first incubator, in Conakry](<https://saboutech.org/>). It describes a one-year incubation and a 12 to 24 month acceleration, and says it has incubated more than 35 startups since 2016. In the last twelve months, in August 2026, [the head of Lengo Pay said Guinea's incubators and hubs are judged on youths trained and workshops held](<https://business360.media/startups-guinee-diagnostic-dg-lengo-pay/>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In April 2024 [We Are Tech Africa said The Hub, a technology incubator in Banjul set up in October 2019, offers incubation programmes, training and acceleration sessions](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/tech-stars/gambias-beran-dondeh-gillen-empowers-entrepreneurs-through-incubation-training-and-coworking>). [It has supported over 194 entrepreneurs](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/tech-stars/gambias-beran-dondeh-gillen-empowers-entrepreneurs-through-incubation-training-and-coworking>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [Jokkolabs Banjul, a technology incubation hub in Bakau, agreed with LingoAI to host bootcamps, workshops and incubation programmes](<https://lingoai.io/blog/cmshc4wo600009kgnfjhb3q5u>) over three years. No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

On 25 September 2025 [the InoDevGB incubator in Bissau began work](<https://ang.gw/a-incubadora-inodevgb-e-um-projecto-que-representa-um-marco-para-a-juventude-e-o-futuro-do-pais-diz-alfredo-malu/>), training 15 young people chosen from 52 proposals. [InnovaLab in Bissau says it supports startups at every stage with funding, incubation and accelerator programmes](<https://innovalab-gw.org/>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026, [Orange Digital Center Guinea-Bissau, with WARDIP, launched its startup incubation and acceleration programme](<https://pt.linkedin.com/posts/orange-bissau_lan%C3%A7amento-do-programa-de-incuba%C3%A7%C3%A3o-e-activity-7455656510971371520-Hnc7>), with applications open from 1 to 20 May. No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In the last twelve months, in the week of 5 March 2026, [Fundación IDENTIC signed incubation agreements with six winning Campus Connect projects](<https://news.identicge.org/identic-activa-su-programa-de-incubacion-con-seis-proyectos-tecnologicos-de-alto-potencial/>). In December 2025 [Dreams Hub ended a 12-week programme for 15 finalist startups with a Demo Day](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/dreams_hub_culmina_un_exitoso_demo_day_y_lanza_el_fondo_dreams_de_innovacion>). [Dreams Hub, an AfriLabs member in Malabo, runs La Cápsula, a space for incubating new ventures](<https://africanian.com/livenews/equatorial-guinea-dreams-hub-and-andege-explore-potential-areas-of-collaboration/>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In October 2025 [iHUB's Spark Accelerator, run with Safaricom, M-PESA Africa and Sumitomo, took a second cohort of ten startups](<https://ihub.co.ke/the-spark-accelerator-program-unveils-the-second-cohort-to-drive-innovation-and-scale-in-africa/>) from over 200 applicants. It ran for three months. In the last twelve months, [the ICT ministry, Konza Technopolis and UNDP opened a Kenya AI Accelerator Programme to applicants until September 2026](<https://investdesk.africa/2026/10/22/african-governments-become-customers-for-local-ai/>). In August 2026 [Konza Technopolis agreed with AWS to set up a Startup and Innovation Centre of Excellence at Konza](<https://itweb.africa/article/aws-konza-team-up-on-hybrid-cloud-infrastructure/dgp45vaBlRg7X9l8>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In July 2024 [Vice President Koung opened the University Innovation Pod-Liberia](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/digital-skills-crucial-for-liberia-s-future/article_37d0f1ea-48d2-11ef-b457-7b5bb65625db.html>), a makerspace run by iCampus Liberia with UNDP. In the last twelve months, on 30 June 2026, [UNDP and partners launched LiYEPA, a six-month pilot accelerator](<https://www.undp.org/liberia/news/ideas-impact>). [It offers incubation, mentoring and support for prototypes](<https://www.undp.org/liberia/news/ideas-impact>), and [applications were open at the launch](<https://www.undp.org/liberia/news/ideas-impact>). No cohort of startups has been found for it. Establishing would need a hub or incubator in service running an incubation or acceleration programme with a cohort of startups.

In May 2025 [the Silphium Labs incubator in Al-Bayda completed its second cohort](<https://spark.ngo/celebrating-winners-of-silphium-labs-second-incubation-cycle-in-libya/>): 21 startups, chosen from 228 applicants. [The Asarya Business Incubator in Benghazi ran a six-month incubation for 26 startups](<https://spark.ngo/ten-startups-win-a-total-of-100000-euros-in-seed-funding-at-asarya-startup-competition/>), ending in August 2024. [The National Programme for Micro and Small Enterprises runs an incubation programme at its technology incubator in Tripoli](<https://sme.gov.ly/business-incubators/information-and-communications-technology-business-incubator/>). No source found since October 2023 says a science or technology park is in service with tenants. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Mature would need a science or technology park in service with companies or startups as tenants.

The World Bank says [the CAFI Entrepreneurship Hub runs a six-month incubation with mentoring and grants](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2026/09/15/entrepreneurs-at-work-creating-jobs-and-innovation-in-lesotho>). It has run five cohorts and supported 464 small firms since 2022. In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [its fifth incubation cycle took in 60 enterprises](<https://www.lena.gov.ls/cafi-entrepreneurship-hub-launches-5th-cycle-incubation-programm/>). CAFI's October 2026 newsletter [records 260 enterprises incubated](<https://theafricacapitalreport.com/lesotho-startup-funding/>). No source found since October 2023 says hubs with programmes are in service in two or more cities. Operating would need hubs with programmes in service in two or more cities.

In July 2026 [the Morocco Accelerator, run by Technopark Morocco with Plug and Play, closed its second three-month cohort of 19 startups](<https://www.lavieeco.com/tech/start-up/morocco-accelerator-la-2e-cohorte-cloturee-plus-de-20-mdh-leves/>) and opened a third. [Agadir Technopark, open since December 2021, has supported 142 startups and digital firms through three programmes](<https://en.yabiladi.com/articles/details/183461/agadir-innovation-powered-technopark-cism.html>). [The Essaouira technopark, opened in November 2023, is home to startups and SMEs in ICT, green tech and cultural industries](<https://www.iasp.ws/activities/news/technopark-morocco-inaugurates-its-6th-site-in-essaouira>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, [Orange Maroc joined Technopark Maroc in an AI Garden programme for startups](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/04/09/orange-maroc-partners-technopark-to-accelerate-ai-and-digital-transformation/>). How many startups are tenants of the technoparks has not been found. Whether the Khemisset technopark has opened has not been found.

In the last twelve months, in January 2026, [45 projects selected under Miary Digital finished an incubation of more than nine months, and 26 won grants](<https://2424.mg/transformation-digitale-26-startups-issues-de-huit-regions-subventionnees-a-hauteur-de-15-000-dollars-chacune/>).
